description: Save the yearly goal, or replace it with the next one. Rejects with problems[] if the rubric fails. Keeps levers and projects. area is which of the five life areas the goal belongs to.

baseline.description: value today; required for kind count

kind.description: count (default): a number from baseline to target, e.g. "15 paying customers". done: a one-time result checked yes or no, e.g. "launch v2 in the stores"; no metric, baseline or target, progress is the share of stages done

name: set_goal
title: Set goal
